# 2026 match fixtures

`tba_2026marea_matches.json` contains the unchanged qualification 1 and 2 records from the upstream match API fixture for the 2026 FIRST Mid-Atlantic District Championship. The tests pair these records with local scouting observations to verify official scoring, normalization and audit results. [The Blue Alliance fixture](https://github.com/the-blue-alliance/the-blue-alliance/blob/3bbacfc2961433235e2427b2f52d9046345f4275/src/backend/common/helpers/tests/data/2026marea_matches.json)
